capabilities: Fetch Flomo memos via token auth or desktop auto-login
Merge each month's memos into a single Markdown file
Organize output into per-year folder templates
Incrementally sync new, updated, and deleted memos
Offer alternate layouts: by tag, by date, or one file per memo
disambiguation: Not a vault or cross-device sync tool; it only pulls memos from the Flomo service into notes.
extras: Desktop only; auto-login requires the desktop app. Not yet listed in the community directory, so manual install or BRAT is needed. README also contains maintainer release-checklist content unrelated to usage.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull memos from the Flomo service into local notes, so users must copy content manually or lose update tracking.

relations.evidence: This plugin calls the Flomo API at flomoapp.com to fetch your memos

requires.name: Flomo account (for access token or auto-login)

summary: Syncs Flomo memos into the vault as Markdown notes, merging each month into one file with per-year folders and incremental updates.
